title: Mid-Week Revival: Get Serious About the Things of God
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges listeners to take their faith seriously and stop playing spiritual games. He shares personal stories of how he committed to living a life centered on God's Word, and encourages listeners to do the same, promising that it will bring them spiritual growth, prosperity, and a deeper relationship with God. Don't miss this urgent call to move from superficial faith to a life of true devotion.
